items.excerpt: Figma now lets designers author custom Skills for the Figma agent directly inside the product, and publish them to the Community. The post highlights ten featured skills spanning visual effects, design documentation and usability-testing workflows.

A UX guide to where AI features should physically live in an interface — sidebar, inline, modal or command bar — arguing that placement shapes whether users ever perceive or adopt the AI at all. It offers a framework for balancing discoverability against workflow interruption.

Exa's neural search engine has joined the Vercel Agent Marketplace, letting builders ground agents in fresh, current information with unified billing and API management. It plugs web research directly into agent-built products.

Grok Build is now a supported adapter in the AI SDK harness layer, which runs established coding-agent runtimes through one unified interface. Teams can swap the underlying agent runtime without changing application code.

The AI SDK harness layer now supports any Agent Client Protocol (ACP)-compatible harness via a new @ai-sdk/harness-acp package. One protocol adapter unlocks a whole family of coding agents for prompt-driven prototyping stacks.

PTC's new Onshape FeatureScript MCP Server lets users describe a desired CAD feature in natural language and have AI build and refine the custom tool. It targets repeated modelling bottlenecks by turning them into bespoke buttons.

Leo AI CEO Maor Farid claims his design agent has passed a "mechanical Turing test," producing manufacturing-ready CAD assemblies from a spec. The agent asks leading questions and exposes its reasoning rather than just emitting geometry.

New EU guidelines require clearly labelling AI-generated content for anyone serving EU citizens, effective August 2, 2026. The rules cover deepfakes, chatbots, AI-written text and biometric tools — pushing designers to build disclosure into the UI itself.

The DevTools "blocked aria-hidden" warning is legitimate: focus must leave a region before it becomes hidden. Common fixes like blur() or setTimeout actually strand screen-reader users on <body> instead of returning them to the trigger.

Marmoset shipped Toolbag 5.03, a free update to its real-time rendering and look-dev tool. It adds Text and Scatter Layers for texturing, IES light profiles with physical light units, and 3Dconnexion SpaceMouse support.

Ephere released Ornatrix 4 for Cinema 4D, bringing the hair, fur and feather system to parity with other hosts. New is a Warp Roots modifier for feathers and sparse fur, plus painting through decals to texture hair.

Untold Studios published a making-of for the animated title sequence of the live-action Masters of the Universe, showing the forging of He-Man's Power Sword. The breakdown covers the procedural geometry and cloud simulations beneath the shot.

3D VFX artist Sherzod Kadirov released a free Blender tool that uses Geometry Nodes to procedurally turn hair-groom curves into feathers. It supports custom feather shapes and works on animated characters.
Spline Architect 2.7.2 adds GPU instancing, making it possible to distribute and move up to a million objects along splines. The update targets large-scale procedural environment layout.

LA studio Impossible Objects runs fine-tuned generative models locally on HP ZGX Nano workstations, blending them with traditional compositing on high-profile ad work. Keeping inference on-prem protects client IP while expanding production capacity.

A practical breakdown of image upscaling, contrasting classic pixel-averaging methods like bicubic with AI models that predict detail from training data. The tradeoff: AI gets you sharper results but can invent things that were never in the original.

James C. Kane built an immersive gel, sand and water simulation running in the browser on Apple Vision Pro using WebXR, WebGPU and Three.js. He claims it's the first real-time sim of its kind delivered entirely through the web on the headset.
